title: ES 4 RXV · Directional trend lengths
summary: How many candles form each bullish and bearish trend? Overall, annual, session and annual-by-session evidence from the 2019–2026 ES Range XV export.

sections.title: What is measured
sections.body: ES 4-tick Range XV. A bullish trend is consecutive completed candles with close above open; a bearish trend uses close below open. A doji ends a trend. Length counts candles, not minutes. Exact lengths require an observed start and an observed opposite/doji breaker. Boundary-limited runs are shown as censored. These are descriptive chart statistics, not a trading result.

sections.title: Overall trend lengths
sections.description: Lengths in candles, conditional on fully observed trend starts and ends. Censored counts are excluded from length estimates.
notes: Trend = consecutive completed candles with the same close-open sign. Dojis break the run.
Groups use the first candle's opening time. The full run is retained across named window boundaries.
Mode shows the smallest tied value; all ties are retained in the summary CSV. Empty estimates are not available.

sections.title: Windows, boundaries and data limits
sections.body: All clock windows use inferred America/New_York wall time, including seasonal clock changes. Start included; end excluded. Asia 20:00–02:00; London 02:00–09:00; NY 09:30–16:00; Asia Open 19:30–21:30; NY Open 09:30–10:30; NY AM 10:30–12:30; NY PM 12:30–16:00. Windows overlap independently, so their counts cannot all be added. Unassigned clock hours remain in all-hours totals. Year follows the inferred 18:00 trading-session date. 2019 and 2026 are partial coverage years. The entire partial final session, September 24, 2026, is excluded. Unknown session-end bar completion breaks continuity; trends never stitch across sessions. Exact-length estimates are conditional on uncensored runs; they may differ from boundary-limited runs. Same-second candles and identical rows retain source order. OHLC is available and volume is absent; exact last-trade timing and contract/roll treatment are unverified. No population confidence intervals or predictive trading claims are made.

Trend lengths use complete starts/ends; first and terminal runs in each segment can be censored.
